title: Spinning toy
abstract: A spinning toy comprising a plastic disc with a central dome area sized to fit over a finger and a radial skirt section for rotational balance. The toy can be spun on a finger, stick, rod, or pen. Various decorative designs are possible including painted clown faces, dots forming spirals, sequential figures, molded three-dimensional features, dice with letters or numbers, and messages that become 'subliminal' when spinning.
gist: This invention describes a handheld spinning toy for amusement and fidgeting. A thin plastic dome fits over a user's finger with an outer skirt section providing rotational balance during spinning. Widely cited as the ancestor of the fidget spinner.
